point verb

with a finger

also point at, pointing

classical

Traupman 98

digitum ad aliquem intendere

point at someone

Other words

  • digitō intentō — pointing

    also used · classical

Examples

  • Theodōrus pittam cum cucurbitulīs, melongēnīs, piperītidibus rubrīs poposcit, nōn per patrem sed ipse, digitō in imāginem intentō.

    Theo asked for the pitta with courgettes, aubergines and red peppers, not through Dad but himself, pointing at the picture.Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

SourcesLewis & Short: intendo

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 98.
